kind: PRE-REGISTRATION (written before the arm was run against the bed)
probe: FOLLOW-UP 2 to ARM 1 -- head-dilution attribution, harmonic tier off
finding_under_test: verify_a1_recompute_2026-09-01.json section 6b: over the 107 needles where gold is found in BOTH ARM-1 arms, moving admission from 48/50 to 1000/1000 gives better=0 / same=38 / worse=69. Suspect: the Tier-5 harmonic boost (knowledge_store.py:3624-3663) scores the PRE-shortlist pool with a quantized constant bonus and the RRF fuser breaks the resulting ties by gene_id, so gold's harmonic rank becomes a lottery whose size grows with the pool (50 -> 1000).
decision_rule: KILL the harmonic-tie hypothesis if, with the harmonic tier removed and the deep knobs unchanged (fts5_candidate_depth=1000, bm25_shortlist_size=1000), gold's new-arm-vs-shipped fused rank shift over the 107 both-found needles still has worse >= 50 (i.e. at least half the dilution survives). PASS (dilution is a harmonic/tie artefact) if worse <= 20 and better+same >= 87. Anything else is INCONCLUSIVE. Needles where the new arm fails to find gold at all count as WORSE.
switch_substitution: The handoff pre-registered [cymatics] harmonic_links = false. VERIFIED NOT LIVE on this path: its only consumer is context_manager.py:2469, inside the 'if not read_only:' tail-write block (it gates WRITING harmonic edges after a turn), and every ERB query runs read_only=True -- so flipping it would have been a no-op arm. Tier 5's retrieval-side gate is the use_harmonic kwarg (knowledge_store.py:3629), which build_context/_retrieve never passes (hardwired True); the HTTP /context route exposes it as profile == 'quality' (routes_context.py:804). The config-file off switch is [retrieval] harmonic_weight (config.py:861 -> sharding.build_genome_kwargs:681 -> KnowledgeStore._harmonic_weight), which at 0.0 zeroes the additive bonus AND short-circuits fuser.add_tier (fusion.py:146-150). THIS ARM USES harmonic_weight = 0.0. The decision rule above is unchanged from the handoff.
known_before_the_run: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM harmonic_links on F:/tmp/erb_blob_v09x.db = 0 (read-only SQL). The table exists, so the _has_harmonic guard passes, but it holds no edges.

SQLITE_LIMIT_VARIABLE_NUMBER = 32766 (sqlite 3.50.4). The Tier-5 query binds the pre-shortlist candidate id list TWICE (gene_id_a IN (...) AND gene_id_b IN (...)), and a 2-needle smoke measured the pre-shortlist pool (KnowledgeStore.last_tier_contributions, assigned at knowledge_store.py:3806 BEFORE the shortlist filter rebinds the local) at ~2.2e5 documents -- about 4.4e5 bound parameters, which raises OperationalError (too many SQL variables) and is swallowed at :3662-3663. This is independent of BOTH admission knobs (the tag lanes carry no LIMIT), so it holds identically for the shipped arm.

Therefore the arm is EXPECTED to reproduce deep1000 and the pre-registered rule is EXPECTED to return KILL. It is run as written anyway, both to honour the pre-registration and because it doubles as a run-to-run reproducibility measurement of the deep arm -- verify_a1_recompute found the delivered SET reproducible but the slate ORDER not, and never tested rank_of_first_gold reproducibility.
